comment: Gear evolution line data (Stage 2, T1->T2). Eras: 0 classic, 1 kunark, 2 planar, 3 velious, 4 growth/mischief. A set marked crafted can be a form (transition target) but never fodder.

catalysts.comment: Crescent Reach redesign (2026-10-27): armor combines burn stackable catalyst materials, not armor pieces. slotCosts = units per combine by vessel slot (every combine, ripening or transition). families are keyed by the vessel's CURRENT form (tier): form 1 burns Decaying, form 2 burns Rubicite, form 3 burns Sebilite. The material within a family follows the vessel's material class (a line may override with catalystCategory — beastlord is leather).
